title: RVD makes the Television title his calling card
summary: Rob Van Dam’s athletic confidence and Bill Alfonso’s assistance turn the Television championship into a central ECW attraction. Injury, rather than an in-ring title defeat, ultimately interrupts the reign.

chapters.title: Van Dam wins the Television championship
chapters.result: Van Dam defeats Bigelow for the title.
chapters.context: Sabu’s interference helps launch the lengthy reign. The date is the live match, before its television broadcast.

chapters.title: Injury forces the title vacancy
chapters.result: Van Dam relinquishes the Television championship after an actual injury.
chapters.context: The vacancy ends his 700-day reign without a championship loss in the ring and opens a tournament for his successor.
